purpose: Teach: 非課税/管区/掌握/発現/短調/寛大/トップクラス/発効

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、非課税口座を悪用した詐欺もあるのですね
lines.en: So the police investigate fraud involving misused tax-free accounts.
lines.style: Attentive, genuinely curious tone. Lean forward slightly. Warm acknowledgment of the other person's expertise. Clear enunciation on key terms.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、警察管区制度を運営されてますね
lines.en: And you manage the police district system, don't you.
lines.style: Respectful observation, no interrogation. Gentle rising inflection at the end. Making space for them to elaborate if they want to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪組織の掌握も進められますね
lines.en: You're also working to get a better handle on organized crime operations.
lines.style: Steady, thoughtful delivery. Slight emphasis on 'better handle'—recognition of ongoing effort. Measured pace, grounded.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、薬物の発現症状にも対応されますね
lines.en: And you respond to the presenting symptoms of drug-related cases too.
lines.style: Gentle, practical tone. Slight nod in the voice. Not casual, but not heavy either. Acknowledging the range of what they handle.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、被害者の声を短調に抑えてサポートされますね
lines.en: You support victims by keeping their experience grounded and manageable.
lines.style: Quiet, careful phrasing. Slight softness in tone—this matters. Thoughtful pause before speaking. Respect for the sensitivity of the subject.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、初犯には寛大な対応もされますね
lines.en: You're lenient with first-time offenders too, aren't you.
lines.style: Warm observation tinged with approval. Light, conversational lilt. Not questioning—affirming what they're already doing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、トップクラスの捜査技術をお持ちですね
lines.en: Your investigative techniques are genuinely world-class.
lines.style: Direct, sincere compliment. Steady eye-contact level. Delivered without flattery—matter-of-fact recognition of expertise.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、改正法の発効日に合わせ運用されますね
lines.en: And you adjust your operations to align with the effective date of amended legislation.
lines.style: Slightly more formal register. Precise, professional delivery. Careful enunciation of 'amended legislation.' Administrative respect.
